mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 60-degree temperatures with partly cloudy skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a beautiful Full Moon is expected for your evening.
The city is currently reviewing the 2027 proposed budget and planning for the November 4th Plan Commission meeting, which will cover several projects including new plats and site plans.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today, yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, and trivia nights starting this Monday.

Regarding local safety, the Verona Police Department reported that on October 15th, an officer arrested a school bus driver for O W I after observing dangerous driving behavior while students were on board.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Snickers Swirl, and the restaurant is open now until 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
